newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK govt to auction two plots of land on Dec 11.
newsitem.headline: HK govt to auction two plots of land on Dec 11.

text.p: The Hong Kong government said on Friday it would auction two pieces of government land on December 11.

The first site, a 1,222.6-square-metre plot at Electric Road in North Point, is intended for non-industrial purposes, excluding godown, warehouse, hotel, service apartment, petrol filling station and private residential use, it said.
The second site, a 222-square-metre plot located in San Po Kong, is designated for non-industrial use for the lower three floors and private residential use for the remainder.
